name: Warden Thelwater
summary: In Stormwind, a prison riot has left Warden Thelwater besieged at the Stockade entrance. He calls for capable adventurers to stop the Defias prisoners before the uprising reaches the city above.

sections.title: A Crisis in the Canals
sections.body: Beneath Stormwind's canals, the Stockade holds the kingdom's most dangerous miscreants, petty thieves, and political conspirators. Warden Thelwater was charged with keeping them locked away, but an organized revolt caught the guards off guard. The prisoners overwhelmed security and seized the cells, leaving Thelwater barricaded at the entrance as he struggles to contain an armed uprising beneath the capital's streets.

sections.title: Containing the Truth
sections.body: Thelwater wants to keep panic from reaching Stormwind's streets, so he handles the uprising in secret. Bazil Thredd, the revolt's mastermind, holds great influence among the Defias Brotherhood prisoners. Fearing the riot will expose weaknesses in Stormwind's rule, Thelwater turns to outside mercenaries to enter the cellblocks, defeat the ringleaders, and quietly take back the prison.

faq.answer: Warden Thelwater is the human official at the Stockade entrance in Stormwind City. He manages the high-security prison.

A coordinated revolt broke out among the prisoners, led chiefly by members of the Defias Brotherhood. They overpowered the guards and seized the cellblocks, leaving Thelwater and his remaining men pinned near the entrance.

faq.q: Who is leading the prison riot?
faq.answer: Bazil Thredd directs the revolt from deep inside the prison. He commands the Defias inmates and led their sudden strike against the guards.

faq.q: Why hasn't the Stormwind City Guard intervened in force?
faq.answer: Thelwater wants to settle the crisis quietly. News that Stormwind's most fortified dungeon fell to its own inmates could spread panic, so he calls on discreet adventurers to regain control inside.

faq.q: What kind of prisoners are kept here?
faq.answer: The Stockade holds petty crooks, thieves, murderers, and dangerous political insurgents, including high-ranking members of the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: Where can Warden Thelwater be found?
faq.answer: Warden Thelwater is stationed just outside the Stockade entrance, near the canals between the Mage Quarter and Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you can help Warden Thelwater restore order in Stormwind and keep the prison mutiny from threatening the capital's citizens.
As a paladin devoted to order and justice, you can help Warden Thelwater contain violent criminals and restore discipline.
As a rogue, you enter the Stockade amid the fallout of Defias intrigue and prison politics.
